notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K of DuPont de Nemours, Inc. (CIK 1666700, accession 0001666700-25-000005) and its 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-25-071813, ownership as of March 14, 2025). Ellen Kullman is a former CEO of the predecessor E. I. du Pont de Nemours and Company (EIDP); the 10-K describes today's DuPont de Nemours, Inc. as the product of the DWDP Merger with EIDP. She does not appear anywhere in the 2025 proxy, whose table covers current directors and nominees, current named executive officers and more-than-5% holders, so status is no-reported-stake. 5% HOLDERS: both rest on Schedule 13G amendments reporting holdings at the end of 2023, so they are stale relative to the March 2025 share count. DIVIDENDS: $635 million paid to stockholders; $26 million of distributions to noncontrolling interests is a separate line and excluded. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line 'Purchases of common stock and forward contracts' ($500m) is cash paid to repurchase DuPont's own stock; the $21 million excise tax paid on treasury stock purchases is a separate line and not included. No XBRL fact for this line was found in the SEC companyfacts API, so it has no xbrl object. STOCK COMP: $77 million is from the FY2024 10-K. SEC XBRL shows that a later 10-K (accession 0001666700-26-000013) restated 2024 to $56 million; the original figure is used to match the FY2024 snapshot. GEOGRAPHY: the FY2024 10-K's net trade revenue table, before any later recast. No broad employee stock purchase plan was identified in the 10-K, so plan is null.
